title: 4 Bedroom | Sleeps 10 | Huge Outdoor Space
description:
This stylish stay is perfect for group trips. Easily sleep 10 people to the King, Queen, and single sized beds with another 1 or 2 on the sectional. The home boasts soaring ceilings in the main room and wonderful natural light in all rooms. The incredible backyard can be converted into an event space. Games, TVs, newly renovated bathrooms, and even a meditation room—its the perfect reunion house for your friends and family. Home is located 17 miles/27 mins from Broadway.

The space
— SLEEPING SITUATION —

*Total occupancy is 10-12 people max*

Bedroom 1—Sleeps 2
King bed
- Attached full bathroom includes double vanity with large walk-in shower.

Bedroom 2—Sleeps 2
Queen bed
- Detached full bathroom includes vanity with combo tub & shower. Shared with bedroom 3.

Bedroom 3—Sleeps 2
Queen bed
- Detached full bathroom includes vanity with combo tub & shower. Shared with bedroom 2.

Common area 1—Sleeps 1+
Large sectional sofa
- Sleeps 1-2

Bedroom 4—Sleeps 4
2 Adult Twin Daybeds with 2 pullout Trundle beds under each
- located on floor 2
- Sleeps 1 in each twin bed
- Sleeps 4
- Detached full bathroom includes double vanity with large walk-in shower.

Guest access
Guests have access to all of the home except for the locked storage room. Guest access includes the outdoor spaces, garage, and all interiors of the two-story home.

Other things to note
- No unauthorized parties at our property. This will result in immediate eviction and $1,000 minimum fine.
